visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with short black hair and pigtails, wearing a brown tomato-patterned t-shirt and white pants, stands in a brightly lit indoor playroom with white padded walls and wooden toy bins. She holds a large light-colored wooden block while an adult woman in a striped shirt and yellow mask sits behind her. (2) The camera moves to a close-up of the girl's face as she looks curiously toward an off-screen person, her eyes wide and mouth slightly open. She extends her hand holding the block as if to offer it. (3) The girl attempts to climb over the white padded barrier, lifting one leg over while looking at the woman in the background. The background shows a window with trees and a play tent. (4) The girl stands by the barrier, holding a different, smaller wooden block. She looks down at the block and then back up at the camera with a serious expression. (5) An adult hand enters the frame from the bottom, offering a round wooden block to the girl. She reaches out with small fingers to touch and grasp the new object. (6) The girl holds the round block while the adult hand playfully pulls it away, causing her to squint and look puzzled. The lighting remains bright and natural throughout.
